description: typesafe-dispatch hooks: (1) UserPromptSubmit — detect build-shaped/multi-step prompts and inject a one-line reminder to run the typesafe-dispatch skill; simple requests pass through untouched. (2) PreToolUse — subagent-guard: while a guarded subagent works, every consequential Bash/Edit/Write is checked (deterministic destructive patterns always block; read-only commands pass; otherwise a Jev on_spec judgment blocks off-spec actions immediately with a corrective reason; 3 strikes stops the subagent). Guard a dispatch by pushing an ENGLISH spec with guard-spec.mjs push '<spec>' before spawning.
